reason: Based on repository evidence, this plugin is primarily a user-facing DeepSeek Harness business cockpit that visualizes ecommerce operational metrics and supports operational decision workflows, with features matching data overview, anomaly detection, action planning, and Q&A on imported or connected business data. It is classified under visualization because the core value is interactive dashboard/operational reporting rather than code generation or infrastructure tooling.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向电商经营场景的 DeepSeek Harness 持久化插件，在网页界面展示经营数据看板、异常与机会洞察、行动清单，并支持 CSV 导入与自然语言提问。
summaries.en: This is a persistent DeepSeek Harness web plugin for ecommerce operations that shows data dashboards, anomaly and opportunity insights, and action lists, with support for CSV input and natural-language queries.

capabilities: KPI dashboard rendering in a web client
CSV data ingestion and basic metric processing
Action list generation with priority/time/owner fields
Optional integration with external ecommerce/platform data sources
